commonPoints: A peephole camera replaces the existing door viewer with no drilling
Ring's Peephole Cam is the default pick; Brinno, Remo+ DoorCam and LCD digital viewers are alternatives
Buying criteria: video, battery, Wi-Fi, two-way audio, motion detection, night vision
ourGain: Ring Peephole Cam 2K removes the optical peephole (Ring product page; The Gadgeteer)
Exact fit range: doors 1.28-2.36 in, peepholes 12-14 mm (Ring)
Wyze sells no peephole camera; the request has been 'Maybe Later' on the Wyze forum wishlist since 2019
Renter install, move-out and hallway privacy steps
